newsitem.title: USA: Cabot names Robert Culver as CFO.
newsitem.headline: Cabot names Robert Culver as CFO.

text.p: Cabot Corp said Friday it named Robert Culver as executive vice president and chief financial officer effective April 15.
Culver replaces Kenyon Gilson, who intends to resign for personal reasons, Cabot said.

Cabot said Culver most recently served as senior vice president and treasurer of Northeastern University. Before joining the school, Culver was connected with Coopers & Lybrand Mangement Consulting Services, where he was a partner in charge of health care consulting practice, it said.
In his new position, Culver will be responsible for Cabot's planning, control, treasury, tax, internal audit and investor relations departments, it said.
Cabot is a specialty chemicals and materials company with global operations.
